cohort: Women with singleton or twin pregnancies who had an abnormal GCT result between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation and subsequently underwent an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT).
finding: The highest incidence of GDM diagnosis was found in patients who underwent GCT between 26.0 and 26.6 weeks of gestation, while the lowest rates were observed between 24.0 and 24.6 weeks.
gest_age: Gestational age at GCT was 24-28 weeks
